It’s not personal most of the time.\n\nDoctor: Have you been feeling like you have special powers, talents, or importance beyond what other people would believe?\n\nPatient: Special powers? No, I don’t think so. I mean, everybody at work has something they’re good at. I can usually tell when a display’s going to block traffic before somebody knocks over the shampoo rack, but that’s just from doing it a long time.\n\nImportance beyond other people… I don’t know. I’m a supervisor, so people do come to me for things, keys, overrides, complaints about coupons that expired two months ago. But that’s not special, that’s just the job. I wouldn’t say powers or anything like that.\n\nDoctor: Have you started using any drugs, or had any new medical illness or head injury, around the time these problems began?\n\nPatient: Drugs? No, I mean, not that I can think of. I haven’t started anything like that. Medical illness… I don’t know, I get the usual stuff, aches, the back thing if I’m standing too long on the sales floor, but that’s been years, you know, concrete floors are terrible for people.\n\nHead injury, no… I don’t remember hitting my head or anything around then.
